sentences.text:
Author: T. Vinod Kumar
Bench: T. Vinod Kumar
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice T. Vinod Kumar
 Contempt Case No.1195 of 2024
Order:
Contemnors/respondents No.4 & 5 are present before the Court in-person.
2. This Contempt Case has been filed by the petitioner alleging non-compliance and willful disobedience to the order of this Court dt.29.09.2023 in W.P.No.30297 of 2021.

3. Heard learned counsel for petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondents No.1 to 5, and perused the record.
4.

Learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition submits that though initially the subject land was allotted to Tribal Welfare Department, since, the said land is now vested with the revenue authorities, the concerned revenue authorities have initiated land acquisition proceedings by issuing preliminary notification under Section 11(1) of the Act on 23.12.2024.

5. Learned Government Pleader further submits that necessary exemption from application of Chapter - II & III of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short 'the Act') have been obtained and preliminary notification was also published in Andhra Jyothi Telugu vernacular newspaper and Indian Express English newspaper on 25.12.2024.

sentences.text: 6. Learned Government Pleader further submits that since, the respondents-authorities have initiated land acquisition proceedings, the authorities would take further action by passing an Award, within the time frame prescribed under the Act.
7. I have taken note of the aforesaid submissions.

8. Having regard to the submissions made as above, and since, the respondents-authorities have now initiated action in compliance with the direction of this Court, dt.29.09.2023 in W.P.No.30297 of 2021, this Court is of the view that the respondents-authorities have purged themselves of the contempt of the order of this Court.

9. However, respondents-authorities having initiated land acquisition proceedings by issuing preliminary notification under Section 11(1) of the Act, are required to complete the entire process of Mekala Poshetty vs Sri Navin Mittal I.A.S on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97928965/
1 acquisition by adhering to the timelines prescribed under the Act including payment of compensation to the awardee in accordance with the Act.
